raw_html: [[Acid Burst#Acid Burst|Acid Burst]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Acid Burst#Acid Burst|Acid Burst]]:''' This weapon is sheathed in corrosive acid, and does 1 to 6 acid damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 acid damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
